package com.viu


import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonProperty
import com.lagradost.cloudstream3.*
import com.lagradost.cloudstream3.utils.ExtractorLink
import java.util.UUID
import com.lagradost.cloudstream3.utils.newExtractorLink
import com.lagradost.cloudstream3.utils.AppUtils.toJson
import com.lagradost.cloudstream3.utils.AppUtils
import android.R.attr.mimeType
import com.lagradost.cloudstream3.SubtitleFile
import com.lagradost.cloudstream3.utils.Qualities
import com.lagradost.cloudstream3.utils.getQualityFromName
class Viu : MainAPI() {
    override var mainUrl = "https://www.viu.com"
    override var name = "Viu"
    override val hasMainPage = true
    override var lang = "ar"
    override val supportedTypes = setOf(TvType.Movie, TvType.TvSeries, TvType.AsianDrama)

    private val mobileApiUrl = "https://api-gateway-global.viu.com/api/mobile"
    private val tokenUrl = "https://api-gateway-global.viu.com/api/auth/token"
    private val playbackUrl = "https://api-gateway-global.viu.com/api/playback/distribute"

    private val areaId = "1004" // Iraq/MENA
    private val countryCode = "IQ"
    private val languageId = "6" // Arabic
    private var cachedToken: String? = null
    private var tokenExpiry: Long = 0
    private val deviceId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
    private val baseHeaders = mapOf(
        "User-Agent" to "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 12)",
        "Accept" to "application/json",
        "Referer" to "https://www.viu.com/",
        "Origin" to "https://www.viu.com"
    )

    private suspend fun getAuthToken(): String {
        val currentTime = System.currentTimeMillis() / 1000
        if (cachedToken != null && currentTime < tokenExpiry) {
            return cachedToken!!
        }

        val payload = mapOf(
            "countryCode" to countryCode,
            "platform" to "android",
            "platformFlagLabel" to "phone",
            "language" to languageId,
            "deviceId" to deviceId,
            "dataTrackingDeviceId" to UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
            "osVersion" to "33",
            "appVersion" to "2.23.0",
            "buildVersion" to "790",
            "carrierId" to "0",
            "carrierName" to "null",
            "appBundleId" to "com.vuclip.viu",
            "flavour" to "all"
        )

        val response = app.post(
            tokenUrl,
            headers = baseHeaders + mapOf("Content-Type" to "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"),
            data = payload
        ).parsedSafe<TokenResponse>()

        val token = response?.token ?: response?.data?.token
        ?: throw Error("Failed to get Auth Token")

        val expiresIn = response?.expiresIn ?: response?.data?.expiresIn ?: 3600

        cachedToken = token
        tokenExpiry = currentTime + expiresIn

        return token
    }

    private suspend fun getAuthenticatedHeaders(): Map<String, String> {
        val token = getAuthToken()
        return baseHeaders + mapOf("Authorization" to "Bearer $token")
    }
    override suspend fun getMainPage(page: Int, request: MainPageRequest): HomePageResponse {
        val headers = getAuthenticatedHeaders()
        val items = ArrayList<HomePageList>()
        val url = "$mobileApiUrl?r=/home/index" +
                "&platform_flag_label=phone" +
                "&language_flag_id=$languageId" +
                "&ut=0" +
                "&area_id=$areaId" +
                "&os_flag_id=2" +
                "&countryCode=$countryCode"

        val response = app.get(url, headers = headers).parsedSafe<ViuHomeResponse>()
        val data = response?.data ?: return newHomePageResponse(items)
        if (!data.banners.isNullOrEmpty()) {
            val bannerItems = data.banners.mapNotNull { it.toSearchResponse() }
            if (bannerItems.isNotEmpty()) {
                items.add(HomePageList("Featured", bannerItems))
            }
        }
        data.grids?.forEach { grid ->
            val title = grid.name ?: "Unknown Category"
            val products = grid.products?.mapNotNull { it.toSearchResponse() }

            if (!products.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                items.add(HomePageList(title, products))
            }
        }

        return newHomePageResponse(items)
    }
    private fun ViuHomeItem.toSearchResponse(): SearchResponse? {
        val name = this.seriesName ?: this.title?.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() } ?: this.synopsis?.split("-")?.firstOrNull() ?: "Unknown"
        val image = this.coverLandscapeImage
            ?: this.seriesCoverLandscapeImage
            ?: this.imageUrl // البانر عادة يكون أفقي
            ?: this.coverImageUrl // احتياطي عمودي
            ?: this.productImageUrl

        val isMovieType = this.isMovie == 1
        val type = if (isMovieType) TvType.Movie else TvType.TvSeries

        val finalId = if (isMovieType) (this.productId ?: this.id) else (this.seriesId ?: this.id)
        if (finalId == null) return null

        val dataUrl = "$mainUrl/load?type=${if (isMovieType) "movie" else "series"}&id=$finalId"

        return if (isMovieType) {
            newMovieSearchResponse(name, dataUrl, type) {
                this.posterUrl = image
            }
        } else {
            newTvSeriesSearchResponse(name, dataUrl, type) {
                this.posterUrl = image
            }
        }


    }    override suspend fun search(query: String): List<SearchResponse> {
        return search(query, 1)?.items ?: emptyList()
    }
    override suspend fun search(query: String, page: Int): SearchResponseList? {
        val headers = getAuthenticatedHeaders()
        val url =
            "$mobileApiUrl?platform_flag_label=web&r=/search/video" +
                    "&keyword=$query&page=$page&limit=20" +
                    "&area_id=$areaId&language_flag_id=$languageId"

        val resp = app.get(url, headers = headers)
            .parsedSafe<ViuSearchResponse>()

        val results = ArrayList<SearchResponse>()
        resp?.data?.series?.forEach { item ->
            val seriesId = item.seriesId ?: item.id ?: return@forEach
            val title = item.seriesName ?: item.name ?: return@forEach

            val dataUrl = "$mainUrl/load?type=series&id=$seriesId"

            results.add(
                newTvSeriesSearchResponse(
                    title,
                    dataUrl,
                    TvType.TvSeries
                ) {
                    posterUrl = item.coverImage ?: item.posterUrl
                }
            )
        }
        resp?.data?.movies?.forEach { item ->
            val productId = item.productId ?: return@forEach
            val title = item.name ?: item.title ?: return@forEach

            val dataUrl = "$mainUrl/load?type=movie&id=$productId"

            results.add(
                newMovieSearchResponse(
                    title,
                    dataUrl,
                    TvType.Movie
                ) {
                    posterUrl = item.coverImage ?: item.posterUrl
                }
            )
        }
        val merged = results
        return newSearchResponseList(merged, merged.isNotEmpty())
    }



    override suspend fun load(url: String): LoadResponse? {
        val headers = getAuthenticatedHeaders()
        val uri = android.net.Uri.parse(url)
        val seriesId = uri.getQueryParameter("id") ?: return null
        val epUrl = "$mobileApiUrl?platform_flag_label=phone&os_flag_id=2" +
                "&r=/vod/product-list" +
                "&series_id=$seriesId" +
                "&size=1000" +
                "&area_id=$areaId" +
                "&language_flag_id=$languageId"

        val resp = app.get(epUrl, headers = headers).parsedSafe<ViuEpisodeListResponse>()
        val products = resp?.data?.products ?: return null
        if (products.isEmpty()) return null
        val episodes = products.mapNotNull { ep ->
            val ccsId = ep.ccsProductId ?: return@mapNotNull null
            val productId = ep.productId ?: return@mapNotNull null

            newEpisode(ccsId) {
                data = mapOf(
                    "ccs" to ccsId,
                    "pid" to productId
                ).toJson()
                name = ep.synopsis?.trim() ?: "Episode ${ep.number}"

                episode = ep.number?.toIntOrNull()
                posterUrl = ep.coverImage
                description = ep.description
            }
        }.sortedBy { it.episode }
        val first = products.firstOrNull()
        val seriesTitle = first?.seriesCategoryName ?: "Unknown Series" // أو يمكن جلبه من loadLinks لاحقاً

        return newTvSeriesLoadResponse(
            first?.synopsis?.split("-")?.firstOrNull()?.trim() ?: "Viu Series", // محاولة استخراج اسم المسلسل من اسم الحلقة
            url,
            TvType.TvSeries,
            episodes
        ) {
            posterUrl = first?.coverImage
            plot = first?.description
        }
    }
    override suspend fun loadLinks(
        data: String,
        isCasting: Boolean,
        subtitleCallback: (SubtitleFile) -> Unit,
        callback: (ExtractorLink) -> Unit
    ): Boolean {
        println("[VIU-DEBUG] ================= START LOADLINKS =================")
        return try {
            val json = AppUtils.parseJson<Map<String, String>>(data)
            val ccsId = json["ccs"] ?: return false.also { println("[VIU-DEBUG] ❌ Error: ccsId is null") }
            val productId = json["pid"] ?: return false.also { println("[VIU-DEBUG] ❌ Error: productId is null") }

            println("[VIU-DEBUG] Processing Product ID: $productId | CCS ID: $ccsId")

            val headers = mapOf(
                "Authorization" to "Bearer ${getAuthToken()}",
                "User-Agent" to "okhttp/4.12.0",
                "Accept" to "application/json",
                "Referer" to "https://www.viu.com/"
            )
            val detailUrl = "$mobileApiUrl?r=/vod/detail" +
                    "&product_id=$productId" +
                    "&platform_flag_label=phone" +
                    "&language_flag_id=$languageId" +
                    "&area_id=$areaId" +
                    "&os_flag_id=2" +
                    "&countryCode=$countryCode"

            println("[VIU-DEBUG] Fetching Detail URL: $detailUrl")

            val rawResponse = app.get(detailUrl, headers = headers).text

            val detailResp = AppUtils.parseJson<ViuDetailResponse>(rawResponse)
            val currentProduct = detailResp.data?.currentProduct

            if (currentProduct == null) {
                println("[VIU-DEBUG] ⚠️ Warning: current_product is null in JSON response!")
            } else {
                val subsList = currentProduct.subtitles
                println("[VIU-DEBUG] Found Subtitles List Size: ${subsList?.size ?: 0}")

                subsList?.forEachIndexed { index, sub ->
                    val subUrl = sub.url ?: sub.subtitleUrl
                    val subName = sub.name ?: "Unknown"
                    val subCode = sub.isoCode ?: sub.code ?: "und"

                    println("[VIU-DEBUG] [$index] Sub: $subName ($subCode) -> URL: $subUrl")

                    if (!subUrl.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                        subtitleCallback(
                            newSubtitleFile(
                                lang = subCode,
                                url = subUrl
                            )
                        )
                        println("[VIU-DEBUG] ✅ Added Subtitle: $subName")
                    } else {
                        println("[VIU-DEBUG] ❌ Skipped Subtitle: URL is empty")
                    }
                }
            }
            println("[VIU-DEBUG] Fetching Playback Stream...")
            val playUrl = "$playbackUrl?ccs_product_id=$ccsId" +
                    "&platform_flag_label=phone" +
                    "&language_flag_id=$languageId" +
                    "&area_id=$areaId"

            val playResp = app.get(playUrl, headers = headers).parsedSafe<ViuPlaybackResponse>()
            val streams = playResp?.data?.stream?.url

            if (streams.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                println("[VIU-DEBUG] ❌ No video streams found!")
            } else {
                println("[VIU-DEBUG] Found ${streams.size} video qualities.")
                streams.forEach { (q, url) ->
                    callback(
                        newExtractorLink(
                            source = name,
                            name = "Viu ${q.uppercase()}",
                            url = url
                        ) {
                            referer = "https://www.viu.com/"
                            quality = when {
                                q.contains("1080") -> Qualities.P1080.value
                                q.contains("720") -> Qualities.P720.value
                                q.contains("480") -> Qualities.P480.value
                                q.contains("240") -> 240
                                else -> Qualities.Unknown.value
                            }
                        }
                    )
                }



            }

            println("[VIU-DEBUG] ================= END LOADLINKS =================")
            true
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            println("[VIU-DEBUG] 💥 Critical Error in loadLinks: ${e.message}")
            e.printStackTrace()
            false
        }
    }

package com.vodu

import android.widget.Toast
import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonProperty
import com.lagradost.cloudstream3.*
import com.lagradost.cloudstream3.CommonActivity.showToast
import com.lagradost.cloudstream3.LoadResponse.Companion.addActors
import com.lagradost.cloudstream3.LoadResponse.Companion.addTrailer
import com.lagradost.cloudstream3.utils.AppUtils.tryParseJson
import com.lagradost.cloudstream3.utils.ExtractorLink
import com.lagradost.cloudstream3.utils.Qualities
import org.jsoup.nodes.Element
import com.lagradost.cloudstream3.utils.newExtractorLink
import java.net.URLEncoder

class VoduProvider : MainAPI() {
    override var mainUrl = "https://movie.vodu.me"
    override var name = "Vodu"
    override val hasMainPage = true
    override var lang = "ar"
    override val hasQuickSearch = false
    override val supportedTypes = setOf(
        TvType.Movie,
        TvType.TvSeries,
        TvType.Anime
    )

    private val siteHeaders = mapOf(
        "Referer" to "https://movie.vodu.me/",
        "User-Agent" to "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
    )

    override val mainPage = mainPageOf(
        "$mainUrl" to "Featured",
        "$mainUrl/movies" to "Latest Movies",
        "$mainUrl/series" to "Latest Series",
        "$mainUrl/category/15" to "Turkish Series",
        "$mainUrl/category/5" to "Asian Drama",
        "$mainUrl/category/2" to "Anime Series",
        "$mainUrl/category/9" to "Anime Movies",
        "$mainUrl/category/4" to "Arabic Series",
        "$mainUrl/category/7" to "Arabic Movies"
    )

    private fun fixImageUrl(url: String?): String? {
        if (url.isNullOrBlank()) return null
        return url.replace("&amp;", "&").trim()
    }

    override suspend fun getMainPage(page: Int, request: MainPageRequest): HomePageResponse {
        val document = try {
            app.get(request.data, headers = siteHeaders, timeout = 10).document
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            if (e is java.io.IOException ||        // يشمل Canceled, timeout, ConnectException
                e is java.net.UnknownHostException ||
                e is javax.net.ssl.SSLException
            ) {
                showToast(
                    "يبدو ان شبكتك لا تدعم فودو تاكد من انك تفتحه في العراق 🇮🇶 وعلى شبكة مدعومة",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                )
                return newHomePageResponse(emptyList())
            }
            throw e
        }

        val homeItems = ArrayList<HomePageList>()
        val sections = document.select("div:has(h2.tv-row-title)")

        if (sections.isNotEmpty()) {
            for (section in sections) {
                val title = section.selectFirst("h2.tv-row-title")?.text()?.trim() ?: continue
                val items = section.select("a[href*='/item/']").mapNotNull { it.toSearchResponse() }
                if (items.isNotEmpty()) {
                    homeItems.add(HomePageList(title, items))
                }
            }
        } else {
            val items = document.select("div.grid a[href*='/item/']").mapNotNull { it.toSearchResponse() }
            if (items.isNotEmpty()) {
                homeItems.add(HomePageList(request.name, items))
            }
        }

        return newHomePageResponse(homeItems)
    }

    private fun Element.toSearchResponse(): SearchResponse? {
        val link = this.attr("href") ?: return null
        val title = this.selectFirst("p.truncate")?.text()?.trim() ?: return null
        val poster = fixImageUrl(this.selectFirst("img")?.attr("src"))
        val chipText = this.selectFirst("span.ui-chip")?.text()?.lowercase() ?: ""
        val type = if (chipText.contains("series") || chipText.contains("مسلسل")) {
            TvType.TvSeries
        } else {
            TvType.Movie
        }

        return if (type == TvType.Movie) {
            newMovieSearchResponse(title, link, type) {
                this.posterUrl = poster
            }
        } else {
            newTvSeriesSearchResponse(title, link, type) {
                this.posterUrl = poster
            }
        }
    }

    override suspend fun search(query: String): List<SearchResponse>? {
        return search(query, 1)?.items
    }

    override suspend fun search(query: String, page: Int): SearchResponseList? {
        val encoded = URLEncoder.encode(query, "utf-8")
        val searchUrl = "$mainUrl/search?q=$encoded&sort=newest&sortBy=adddate&sortType=desc&p=$page"
        val document = app.get(searchUrl, headers = siteHeaders).document

        val rawElements = document.select("div.grid a[href*='/item/']")
        if (rawElements.isEmpty()) return null

        val parsedList = rawElements.mapNotNull { it.toSearchResponse() }

        fun getMatchScore(title: String?, qLower: String): Int {
            if (title.isNullOrBlank()) return 0
            val tLower = title.lowercase().trim()
            if (tLower == qLower) return 100
            if (tLower.startsWith(qLower)) return 80
            if (tLower.contains(qLower)) return 60
            val tokens = qLower.split(Regex("\\s+")).filter { it.isNotBlank() }
            val tokenMatches = tokens.count { tLower.contains(it) }
            return if (tokenMatches > 0) 40 + tokenMatches else 0
        }

        val ql = query.lowercase().trim()

        val sortedResults = parsedList
            .mapIndexed { index, item ->
                val score = getMatchScore(item.name, ql)
                Triple(item, score, index)
            }
            .sortedWith(
                compareByDescending<Triple<SearchResponse, Int, Int>> { it.second }
                    .thenBy { it.third }
            )
            .map { it.first }
            .distinctBy { it.url }

        val hasNextPage = document.select("a[rel=next], a:contains(›)").isNotEmpty() ||
                document.select("ul.flex a[href*='p=${page + 1}']").isNotEmpty()

        return newSearchResponseList(sortedResults, hasNextPage)
    }

    override suspend fun load(url: String): LoadResponse {
        val document = app.get(url, headers = siteHeaders).document

        val title = document.selectFirst("h1")?.text()?.trim() ?: "Unknown"

        val poster = fixImageUrl(
            document.selectFirst("div.aspect-\\[2\\/3\\] img, div.w-32 img")?.attr("src")
        )

        val rawBackdrop = fixImageUrl(
            document.selectFirst("div.relative.h-\\[45vh\\] img, div.tv-hero img")?.attr("src")
        )

        val backdrop = if (!rawBackdrop.isNullOrBlank()) {
            try {
                val check = app.head(rawBackdrop, headers = siteHeaders)
                if (check.isSuccessful) rawBackdrop else poster
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                poster
            }
        } else {
            poster
        }

        val plot = document.selectFirst("p.max-w-2xl")?.text()?.trim()

        val ratingText = document.selectFirst("span.text-white.font-bold:has(i.fa-star)")?.text()?.trim()
        val score = ratingText?.replace(Regex("[^0-9.]"), "")?.toDoubleOrNull()?.let {
            Score.from10(it)
        }

        val yearText = document.select("div.flex.items-center span").firstOrNull {
            it.text().matches(Regex(".*\\b(19|20)\\d{2}\\b.*"))
        }?.text()
        val year = yearText?.let { Regex("\\b(19|20)\\d{2}\\b").find(it)?.value?.toIntOrNull() }

        val duration = document.select("div.flex.items-center span").firstOrNull {
            it.text().contains("min")
        }?.text()?.replace(Regex("[^0-9]"), "")?.toIntOrNull()

        val genres = document.selectFirst("p:contains(Genres:)")?.text()
            ?.replace("Genres:", "")
            ?.split(",")
            ?.map { it.trim() }

        val actors = document.select("div:has(> h3:contains(Cast)) a[href*='/actor/']").mapNotNull {
            val actorName = it.selectFirst("p")?.text()?.trim() ?: return@mapNotNull null
            val actorImg = fixImageUrl(it.selectFirst("img")?.attr("src"))
            Actor(actorName, actorImg)
        }

        val recommendations = document.select("div:has(> h3:contains(More Like This)) a[href*='/item/']").mapNotNull {
            it.toSearchResponse()
        }

        val trailerId = Regex("""const\s+trailerId\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"""").find(document.html())?.groupValues?.get(1)
        val trailerUrl = if (!trailerId.isNullOrBlank()) "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=$trailerId" else null

        val isSeries = document.select("#seasonTabs, div[id^='seasonPanel_']").isNotEmpty() ||
                document.select("span.ui-chip").any { it.text().contains("Series", true) }

        if (isSeries) {
            val episodes = ArrayList<Episode>()
            val seasonPanels = document.select("div[id^='seasonPanel_']")

            seasonPanels.forEachIndexed { index, panel ->
                val seasonNum = index + 1
                val epElements = panel.select("a[href*='/play/episode/']")

                epElements.forEachIndexed { epIndex, epElement ->
                    val epUrl = epElement.attr("href")
                    val epTitle = epElement.selectFirst("p.font-semibold")?.text()?.trim() ?: "Episode ${epIndex + 1}"
                    val epDesc = epElement.selectFirst("p.text-slate-400")?.text()?.trim()

                    episodes.add(
                        newEpisode(epUrl) {
                            this.name = epTitle
                            this.season = seasonNum
                            this.episode = epIndex + 1
                            this.description = epDesc
                            this.posterUrl = poster
                        }
                    )
                }
            }

            return newTvSeriesLoadResponse(title, url, TvType.TvSeries, episodes) {
                this.posterUrl = poster
                this.backgroundPosterUrl = backdrop
                this.plot = plot
                this.year = year
                this.score = score
                this.tags = genres
                this.recommendations = recommendations
                addActors(actors)
                trailerUrl?.let { addTrailer(it) }
            }
        } else {
            val playUrl = document.selectFirst("a[href*='/play/']")?.attr("href") ?: url.replace("/item/", "/play/")

            return newMovieLoadResponse(title, url, TvType.Movie, playUrl) {
                this.posterUrl = poster
                this.backgroundPosterUrl = backdrop
                this.plot = plot
                this.year = year
                this.duration = duration
                this.score = score
                this.tags = genres
                this.recommendations = recommendations
                addActors(actors)
                trailerUrl?.let { addTrailer(it) }
            }
        }
    }

    override suspend fun loadLinks(
        data: String,
        isCasting: Boolean,
        subtitleCallback: (SubtitleFile) -> Unit,
        callback: (ExtractorLink) -> Unit
    ): Boolean {
        val document = app.get(data, headers = siteHeaders).document
        val html = document.html()
        val qualitiesMatch = Regex("""const\s+qualitiesRaw\s*=\s*(\{.*?\});""").find(html)?.groupValues?.get(1)
        if (!qualitiesMatch.isNullOrBlank()) {
            val qualitiesJson = tryParseJson<Map<String, QualityItem>>(qualitiesMatch)

            qualitiesJson?.forEach { (label, info) ->
                val videoUrl = info.url?.replace("\\/", "/") ?: return@forEach
                val qualityInt = label.toIntOrNull() ?: Qualities.P720.value

                callback.invoke(
                    newExtractorLink(
                        source = name,
                        name = "$name $label" + "p",
                        url = videoUrl,
                    ) {
                        this.referer = "$mainUrl/"
                        this.quality = qualityInt
                    }
                )
            }
        } else {
            val fallbackMatch = Regex("""const\s+fallbackUrl\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"""").find(html)?.groupValues?.get(1)
            fallbackMatch?.let { rawUrl ->
                val videoUrl = rawUrl.replace("\\/", "/")
                callback.invoke(
                    newExtractorLink(
                        source = name,
                        name = "$name Standard",
                        url = videoUrl,
                    ) {
                        referer = "$mainUrl/"
                        quality = Qualities.P720.value
                    }
                )
            }
        }

        val subtitlesMatch = Regex("""const\s+subtitlesRaw\s*=\s*(\[\{.*?\}\]);""").find(html)?.groupValues?.get(1)
        if (!subtitlesMatch.isNullOrBlank()) {
            val subsJson = tryParseJson<List<SubtitleItem>>(subtitlesMatch)

            subsJson?.forEach { sub ->
                val subUrl = sub.path?.replace("\\/", "/") ?: return@forEach
                subtitleCallback.invoke(
                    SubtitleFile(
                        lang = sub.label ?: "Arabic",
                        url = subUrl
                    )
                )
            }
        }

        return true
    }

    data class QualityItem(
        @JsonProperty("url") val url: String?,
        @JsonProperty("type") val type: String?
    )

    data class SubtitleItem(
        @JsonProperty("lang_code") val langCode: String?,
        @JsonProperty("label") val label: String?,
        @JsonProperty("format") val format: String?,
        @JsonProperty("path") val path: String?
    )
}

    private suspend fun resolveSearchBase(): String {

        )

        resolvedSearchBase = finalUrl

        Log.d(logTag, "✅ Resolved search base -> $finalUrl")
        return finalUrl
    }

    @Volatile
    private var currentCfCookie: String? =
        "cf_clearance=ED0NVzmNRSWM57kanLn3lwlIaUBtZI2vPk1ZAP6zyfA-1763125072-1.2.1.1-eWAxOeBZN.zpvnXMgT46AJocpEalzqZ3WXlNZzjhIhJEvbNkRhY1Mz84sv6onyU7zfGBygnr3XbAw955PxJHjnRFUMqcp6o0rbp5wT4hJMMFiUaOSABpAAx.9G7sYlmslO5bpns2BZxvxUlV3onCRMAQY7lUHW.MCZCH10MtRNaPKsDmxvtZo14sQDLEXyu8tEDOAkjElHCHAW3iyseTRNN2j0Zd7ceblYh28.E7PwA;"

    private fun getInterceptor(): Interceptor? {
        return if (currentCfCookie == null) cloudflareKiller else null
    }

    private fun getHeaders(isPost: Boolean = false): Map<String, String> {
        val baseHeaders = if (isPost) postHeaders else standardHeaders
        return currentCfCookie?.let {
            baseHeaders.plus("Cookie" to it)
        } ?: baseHeaders
    }

    private fun parseCfClearance(headers: okhttp3.Headers) {
        headers["Set-Cookie"]?.let { cookieHeader ->
            val newCookie = cookieHeader.split(';').find { it.trim().startsWith("cf_clearance=") }
            if (newCookie != null) {
                Log.d(logTag, "CloudflareKiller obtained a new cookie. Saving it for future requests.")
                currentCfCookie = newCookie
            }
        }
    }

    override val mainPage = mainPageOf(
        "$mainUrl/" to "جديد ماي سيما"
    )

    override var sequentialMainPage = true

    private val userAgent =
        "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 10; K) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/142.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36"

    private val standardHeaders = mapOf(
        "User-Agent" to userAgent,
        "Accept" to "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8",
        "Accept-Language" to "ar-EG,ar;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7",
        "Referer" to "$mainUrl/"
    )

    private val postHeaders = standardHeaders.plus(
        mapOf(
            "Accept" to "application/json, text/javascript, */*; q=0.01",
            "X-Requested-With" to "XMLHttpRequest",
            "Content-Type" to "application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8"
        )
    )

    private suspend fun httpGet(url: String, referer: String? = null): Document {
        if (currentCfCookie != null) {
            try {
                Log.d(logTag, "Attempting GET with current cookie...")
                return app.get(
                    url,
                    referer = referer ?: mainUrl,
                    headers = getHeaders(isPost = false),
                    interceptor = getInterceptor()
                ).document
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.w(logTag, "GET with current cookie failed. It has likely expired. Error: ${e.message}")
                currentCfCookie = null
            }
        }

        Log.d(logTag, "Executing GET with CloudflareKiller to get a new session...")
        val response = app.get(
            url,
            referer = referer ?: mainUrl,
            headers = getHeaders(isPost = false),
            interceptor = getInterceptor()
        )

        parseCfClearance(response.headers)
        return response.document
    }

    private suspend fun httpPost(url: String, data: Map<String, String>, referer: String? = null): String {
        if (currentCfCookie != null) {
            try {
                Log.d(logTag, "Attempting POST with current cookie...")
                return app.post(
                    url,
                    data = data,
                    referer = referer ?: mainUrl,
                    headers = getHeaders(isPost = true),
                    interceptor = getInterceptor()
                ).text
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.w(logTag, "POST with current cookie failed. It has likely expired. Error: ${e.message}")
                currentCfCookie = null
            }
        }

        Log.d(logTag, "Executing POST with CloudflareKiller to get a new session...")
        val response = app.post(
            url,
            data = data,
            referer = referer ?: mainUrl,
            headers = getHeaders(isPost = true),
            interceptor = getInterceptor()
        )
        parseCfClearance(response.headers)
        return response.text
    }

                homePageList.add(HomePageList("مختارات ماي سيما", sliderItems))

val title = pEl.ownText().trim().ifBlank { null }

val year = pEl.selectFirst("span.year")?.text()?.let {

}
                val styleAttr = a.attr("style")

    private fun Element.toSearchResult(): SearchResponse? {
        val anchor = this.selectFirst("a") ?: return null
        val href = fixUrl(anchor.attr("href"))

        val titleElement = this.selectFirst("h2, strong")
        val year = titleElement?.selectFirst("span.year")?.text()?.let {
            Regex("(\\d{4})").find(it)?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toIntOrNull()
        }
        val title = anchor.attr("title").ifBlank {
            titleElement?.text()
        }?.trim() ?: return null

        val posterSpan = this.selectFirst("span.BG--GridItem")
        val styleAttr = posterSpan?.attr("data-lazy-style")?.ifBlank { null }
            ?: posterSpan?.attr("style")?.ifBlank { null }

        val rawPosterUrl = posterSpan?.attr("data-src")?.ifBlank { null }
            ?: styleAttr?.let { style ->
                Regex("url\\(['\"]?(.*?)['\"]?\\)").find(style)?.groupValues?.get(1)
            }?.trim()?.ifBlank { null }

        val posterUrl = rawPosterUrl?.let { fixUrl(it) }

        val isSeries = this.selectFirst(".Episode--number") != null ||
            title.contains("مسلسل") ||
            title.contains("الحلقة")

        val type = if (isSeries) TvType.TvSeries else TvType.Movie

        return newMovieSearchResponse(title, href, type) {
            this.posterUrl = posterUrl
            this.year = year
            this.posterHeaders = imageHeaders()
        }
    }

    private fun imageHeaders(): Map<String, String> {
        val headers = mutableMapOf(
            "User-Agent" to userAgent,
            "Referer" to "$mainUrl/"
        )
        currentCfCookie?.let { headers["Cookie"] = it }
        return headers
    }

    private suspend fun httpGetRaw(url: String): com.lagradost.nicehttp.NiceResponse {
        if (currentCfCookie != null) {
            try {
                Log.d(logTag, "⚡ Fast Check: Attempting GET with cached cookie...")
                val response = app.get(
                    url,
                    referer = mainUrl,
                    headers = getHeaders(isPost = false),
                    interceptor = null
                )

                if (response.code == 200) {
                    return response
                }
                Log.w(logTag, "Cookie expired or invalid (Code: ${response.code})")
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.w(logTag, "Fast check failed: ${e.message}")
                currentCfCookie = null
            }
        }
        Log.d(logTag, "🐢 Slow Check: Triggering CloudflareKiller...")
        val response = app.get(
            url,
            referer = mainUrl,
            headers = getHeaders(isPost = false),
            interceptor = cloudflareKiller
        )
        parseCfClearance(response.headers)
        return response
    }

    private suspend fun getFreshDomainAndCookies(): String {
        return try {
            val response = httpGetRaw(mainUrl)
            val finalUrl = response.url.trimEnd('/')

            if (finalUrl.isNotEmpty() && finalUrl != mainUrl && finalUrl.startsWith("http")) {
                Log.d(logTag, "🚨 Domain Redirect Detected! Updating: $mainUrl -> $finalUrl")
                return finalUrl
            }

            Log.d(logTag, "✅ Domain is valid & Cookies worked.")
            mainUrl
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(logTag, "⚠️ Domain Check Failed: ${e.message}")
            mainUrl
        }
    }

    private suspend fun performSearch(query: String): List<SearchResponse> {
        val activeUrl = getFreshDomainAndCookies()

        if (mainUrl != activeUrl) {
            mainUrl = activeUrl
        }

        val encodedQuery = java.net.URLEncoder.encode(query, "UTF-8")
        val url = "$activeUrl/filtering/?keywords=$encodedQuery&Rated=&genre=&release-years=&category=&quality=&country=&language="
        Log.d(logTag, "🚀 Executing Search GET to: $url")

        return try {
            val document = httpGet(url, referer = activeUrl)
            document.select("div#MainFiltar div.GridItem").mapNotNull {
                it.toSearchResult()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(logTag, "Search Error: ${e.message}")
            emptyList()
        }
    }

    override suspend fun search(query: String): List<SearchResponse> {
        val initialResults = performSearch(query)
        if (initialResults.isEmpty() && query.trim() == "مسلسل") {
            Log.d(logTag, "🔄 Fallback triggered: No results for 'مسلسل', searching for 'game of' instead.")
            return performSearch("game of")
        }
        return initialResults
    }

    override suspend fun load(url: String): LoadResponse {
        Log.d(logTag, "load() initiated with URL: $url")
        val document = httpGet(url)

        val isSeries = url.contains("/series/") ||
    document.selectFirst("div.Seasons--Episodes, div.SeasonsList, div.EpisodesList a, singlesection.Series--Section a") != null

        if (isSeries) {
            val seriesUrl = document.selectFirst("singlesection.Series--Section > a")?.attr("href")
                ?.let { fixUrl(it) }
                ?: url

            val title = document.selectFirst("singlesection.Series--Section h2")?.text()
                ?.replace("حلقات ", "")
                ?.trim()
                ?: document.selectFirst("div.Title--Content--Single-begin h1")?.text()?.trim()
                ?: "TV Series Title"

            val posterUrl = document.selectFirst("wecima.separated--top")?.attr("style")?.let {
                Regex("--img:url\\((.*?)\\)").find(it)?.groupValues?.get(1)
            }?.ifBlank { null }
                ?: document.selectFirst("meta[property=og:image]")?.attr("content")?.ifBlank { null }

            val plot = document.selectFirst("div.StoryMovieContent")?.text()?.trim()

            val year = document.selectFirst("div.Title--Content--Single-begin a[href*='/release-year/']")?.text()
                ?.trim()?.toIntOrNull()
                ?: document.select("ul.Terms--Content--Single-begin li")
                    .find { it.selectFirst("span")?.text()?.contains("السنة") == true }
                    ?.selectFirst("p")?.text()?.trim()?.toIntOrNull()

            val htmlText = document.html()
            val ajaxBase = Regex("""var\s+AjaxtURL\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"""")
                .find(htmlText)?.groupValues?.get(1)
                ?: "$mainUrl/wp-content/themes/mycima/Ajaxt/"

            val postId = Regex("""Single/Episodes\.php.*?post_id:\s*['"](\d+)['"]""", RegexOption.DOT_MATCHES_ALL)
                .find(htmlText)?.groupValues?.get(1)
                ?: document.selectFirst("link[rel=shortlink]")?.attr("href")
                    ?.let { Regex("p=(\\d+)").find(it)?.groupValues?.get(1) }
                ?: ""

            val seasonElements = document.select("div.SeasonsList ul li a")

            fun parseEpisodesFromDoc(
                doc: Document,
                seasonTitle: String,
                seasonNum: Int
            ): List<Episode> {
                return doc.select("a").mapNotNull { epEl ->
                    val epHref = epEl.attr("href").ifBlank { return@mapNotNull null }
                    val epRawName = epEl.selectFirst("episodetitle")?.text()?.trim()
                        ?: epEl.text().trim()
                    val epNum = Regex("(\\d+)").find(epRawName)?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toIntOrNull()

                    val formattedName = if (epNum != null) {
                        "$seasonTitle الحلقة $epNum"
                    } else {
                        "$seasonTitle $epRawName".trim()
                    }

                    newEpisode(fixUrl(epHref)) {
                        this.name = formattedName
                        this.season = seasonNum
                        this.episode = epNum
                        this.posterUrl = posterUrl
                    }
                }
            }

            val episodes: List<Episode> = if (seasonElements.isNotEmpty()) {
                Log.d(logTag, "Found ${seasonElements.size} seasons. Processing...")
                val parsedSeasonNums = seasonElements.map { parseSeasonNumber(it.text()) }
                val usedNumbers = parsedSeasonNums.filterNotNull().toMutableSet()
                var nextMissing = 1
                val resolvedSeasonNums = parsedSeasonNums.map { knownNum ->
                    if (knownNum != null) {
                        knownNum
                    } else {
                        while (usedNumbers.contains(nextMissing)) {
                            nextMissing++
                        }
                        val assigned = nextMissing
                        usedNumbers.add(assigned)
                        nextMissing++
                        assigned
                    }
                }

                seasonElements.mapIndexed { idx, el -> idx to el }.amap { (idx, seasonEl) ->
                    val seasonNum = resolvedSeasonNums[idx]
                    val seasonTitle = seasonEl.text()
                        .replace(Regex("\\s*(مترجم|مدبلج).*"), "")
                        .trim()
                        .ifBlank { "الموسم $seasonNum" }
                    val dataSeason = seasonEl.attr("data-season")

                    try {
                        val seasonHtml = httpPost(
                            "${ajaxBase.trimEnd('/')}/Single/Episodes.php",
                            data = mapOf("season" to dataSeason, "post_id" to postId),
                            referer = url
                        )
                        parseEpisodesFromDoc(Jsoup.parse(seasonHtml), seasonTitle, seasonNum)
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        logError(e)
                        if (seasonEl.parent()?.hasClass("active") == true) {
                            document.selectFirst("div.EpisodesList")?.let { listEl ->
                                parseEpisodesFromDoc(Jsoup.parse(listEl.html()), seasonTitle, seasonNum)
                            } ?: emptyList()
                        } else {
                            emptyList()
                        }
                    }
                }.flatten()
            } else {
                document.selectFirst("div.EpisodesList")?.let { listEl ->
                    parseEpisodesFromDoc(Jsoup.parse(listEl.html()), "الموسم الأول", 1)
                } ?: emptyList()
            }

            val sortedEpisodes = episodes
                .distinctBy { it.data }
                .sortedWith(compareBy({ it.season }, { it.episode }))

            return newTvSeriesLoadResponse(title, seriesUrl, TvType.TvSeries, sortedEpisodes) {
                this.posterUrl = posterUrl
                this.posterHeaders = imageHeaders()
                this.plot = plot
                this.year = year
            }
        } else {
            val title = document.selectFirst("div.Title--Content--Single-begin h1")?.text()?.trim() ?: "Movie Title"
            val posterUrl = document.select("meta[property=og:image]").attr("content").ifBlank {
                document.selectFirst("wecima.separated--top")?.let { element ->
                    val style = element.attr("data-lazy-style").ifBlank { element.attr("style") }
                    Regex("url\\((.*?)\\)").find(style)?.groupValues?.get(1)
                }
            }
            val plot = document.selectFirst("div.StoryMovieContent")?.text()?.trim()
            val year = document.selectFirst("div.Title--Content--Single-begin a[href*='/release-year/']")?.text()
                ?.trim()?.toIntOrNull()
                ?: document.select("ul.Terms--Content--Single-begin li")
                    .find { it.selectFirst("span")?.text()?.contains("السنة") == true }
                    ?.selectFirst("p")?.text()?.trim()?.toIntOrNull()

            return newMovieLoadResponse(title, url, TvType.Movie, url) {
                this.posterUrl = posterUrl
                this.posterHeaders = imageHeaders()
                this.plot = plot
                this.year = year
            }
        }
    }

    private fun decodeWecimaUrl(encodedStr: String): String? {
        return try {
            if (encodedStr.isBlank()) return null
            val cleanedStr = encodedStr.replace("+", "").trim()
            val finalB64Str = if (!cleanedStr.startsWith("aHR0c")) "aHR0c$cleanedStr" else cleanedStr
            String(Base64.decode(finalB64Str, Base64.DEFAULT))
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            logError(e)
            null
        }
    }

    private fun customB64Decode(s: String, alphabet: String): String {
        var bc = 0
        var bs = 0
        val out = mutableListOf<Byte>()
        for (ch in s) {
            val idx = alphabet.indexOf(ch)
            if (idx == -1) continue
            bs = if (bc % 4 != 0) (bs * 64 + idx) else idx
            if (bc % 4 != 0) {
                out.add((0xff and (bs shr ((-2 * (bc + 1)) and 6))).toByte())
            }
            bc++
        }
        return try {
            val pct = out.joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
            URLDecoder.decode("%$pct".replace("%", "%25").replace("%25", "%"), "UTF-8")
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            String(out.toByteArray(), Charsets.UTF_8)
        }
    }

    private fun rc4(s: String, key: String): String {
        val sbox = IntArray(256) { it }
        var j = 0
        for (i in 0 until 256) {
            j = (j + sbox[i] + key[i % key.length].code) % 256
            val temp = sbox[i]; sbox[i] = sbox[j]; sbox[j] = temp
        }
        var i = 0
        j = 0
        val res = StringBuilder()
        for (ch in s) {
            i = (i + 1) % 256
            j = (j + sbox[i]) % 256
            val temp = sbox[i]; sbox[i] = sbox[j]; sbox[j] = temp
            res.append((ch.code xor sbox[(sbox[i] + sbox[j]) % 256]).toChar())
        }
        return res.toString()
    }

    private fun deobfuscateJs(jsCode: String): String {
        val jsId = """[a-zA-Z_$][\w$]*"""
        val decRegex = Regex("""function\s+($jsId)\s*\(\s*($jsId)(?:\s*,\s*$jsId)?\s*\)\s*\{\s*\2\s*=\s*\2\s*([-+])\s*([^;]+);\s*(?:const|let|var)\s+$jsId\s*=\s*($jsId)\s*\(\s*\)\s*;""")
        val mDec = decRegex.find(jsCode) ?: return jsCode

        val decFn = mDec.groupValues[1]
        val op = mDec.groupValues[3]
        val offsetVal = mDec.groupValues[4].trim().toIntOrNull() ?: 0
        val offset = if (op == "+") -offsetVal else offsetVal
        val arrFn = mDec.groupValues[5]

        val arrRegex = Regex("""function\s+${Regex.escape(arrFn)}\s*\(\s*\)\s*\{\s*(?:const|let|var)\s+$jsId\s*=\s*(\[.*?\])\s*;""", RegexOption.DOT_MATCHES_ALL)
        val mArr = arrRegex.find(jsCode) ?: return jsCode
        val rawArrStr = mArr.groupValues[1]

        val arr = Regex("""['"]([^'"]+)['"]""").findAll(rawArrStr).map { it.groupValues[1] }.toMutableList()
        val alphabetMatch = Regex("""['"]([A-Za-z0-9+/=]{64,65})['"]""").find(jsCode)
        val alphabet = alphabetMatch?.groupValues?.get(1)
            ?: "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789+/="

        fun decodeItem(idx: Int, key: String): String {
            val realIdx = idx - offset
            if (realIdx !in arr.indices) return ""
            val raw = arr[realIdx]
            return try {
                if (key.isNotEmpty()) {
                    rc4(customB64Decode(raw, alphabet), key)
                } else {
                    customB64Decode(raw, alphabet)
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                raw
            }
        }

        val callRegex = Regex("""\b${Regex.escape(decFn)}\(\s*(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+)(?:\s*,\s*['"]([^'"]*)['"])?\s*\)""")
        return callRegex.replace(jsCode) { m ->
            val numStr = m.groupValues[1]
            val idx = if (numStr.startsWith("0x")) numStr.substring(2).toInt(16) else numStr.toInt()
            val key = m.groupValues.getOrNull(2) ?: ""
            "\"${decodeItem(idx, key)}\""
        }
    }

    private fun extractDomains(decodedJs: String, currentHost: String): List<String> {
        val domains = mutableListOf<String>()
        val listRegex = Regex("""\b(?:main|dmca)\s*=\s*\[([^\]]+)\]""")
        listRegex.findAll(decodedJs).forEach { match ->
            val content = match.groupValues[1]
            Regex("""['"]([a-zA-Z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,})['"]""").findAll(content).forEach { d ->
                domains.add(d.groupValues[1])
            }
        }
        if (domains.isEmpty()) {
            val domainRegex = Regex("""['"]([a-zA-Z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,})['"]""")
            domainRegex.findAll(decodedJs).forEach { d ->
                val dom = d.groupValues[1]
                if (!dom.contains("google") && !dom.contains("cloudflare") && !dom.endsWith(currentHost)) {
                    domains.add(dom)
                }
            }
        }
        return domains.distinct()
    }

    private suspend fun replaceStreamWishDomain(targetUrl: String, referer: String? = null): String {
        return try {
            val uri = URL(targetUrl)
            val query = if (!uri.query.isNullOrBlank()) "?${uri.query}" else ""
            val path = uri.path

            for (domain in streamWishPreferredDomains) {
                val candidateUrl = "https://$domain$path$query"
                try {
                    val check = app.get(
                        candidateUrl,
                        headers = mapOf(
                            "User-Agent" to userAgent,
                            "Referer" to (referer ?: "https://$domain/")
                        ),
                        timeout = 6
                    )
                    if (check.code == 200 && !check.text.contains("loading", ignoreCase = true)) {
                        return candidateUrl
                    }
                } catch (_: Exception) {}
            }

            "https://${streamWishPreferredDomains.first()}$path$query"
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            targetUrl
        }
    }

    private suspend fun resolveHgCloud(targetUrl: String, referer: String? = null): String? {
        return try {
            val headers = mapOf(
                "User-Agent" to userAgent,
                "Referer" to (referer ?: targetUrl)
            )

            val r1 = app.get(targetUrl, headers = headers, timeout = 8)
            if (r1.code != 200) return null

            val html = r1.text
            val jsPathMatch = Regex("""<script[^>]+src=["']([^"']*main\.js[^"']*)["']""").find(html)
                ?: if (html.lowercase().contains("loading")) Regex("""<script[^>]+src=["'](/[^"']+\.js[^"']*)["']""").find(html) else null

            val uri = URL(r1.url)
            val currentHost = uri.host
            val candidates = mutableListOf<String>()
            candidates.addAll(streamWishPreferredDomains)

            if (jsPathMatch != null) {
                val jsRelative = jsPathMatch.groupValues[1]
                val jsUrl = if (jsRelative.startsWith("http")) jsRelative else "${uri.protocol}://${uri.host}$jsRelative"

                val r2 = app.get(jsUrl, headers = headers, timeout = 8)
                if (r2.code == 200) {
                    try {
                        val decodedJs = deobfuscateJs(r2.text)
                        candidates.addAll(extractDomains(decodedJs, currentHost))
                    } catch (e: Exception) {}
                }
            }

            val uniqueCandidates = candidates.distinct().take(8)

            for (dest in uniqueCandidates) {
                if (dest.equals(currentHost, ignoreCase = true)) continue
                val query = if (!uri.query.isNullOrBlank()) "?${uri.query}" else ""
                val testUrl = "https://$dest${uri.path}$query"

                try {
                    val check = app.get(testUrl, headers = mapOf("User-Agent" to userAgent, "Referer" to r1.url), timeout = 5)
                    if (check.code == 200 && !check.text.contains("loading", ignoreCase = true)) {
                        return testUrl
                    }
                } catch (e: Exception) {}
            }
            null
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    override suspend fun loadLinks(
        data: String,
        isCasting: Boolean,
        subtitleCallback: (SubtitleFile) -> Unit,
        callback: (ExtractorLink) -> Unit
    ): Boolean {
        Log.d(logTag, "🔗 loadLinks initiated for: $data")
        val document = httpGet(data)
        val collectedLinks = linkedMapOf<String, String?>()

        fun addLink(rawUrl: String?, serverName: String?) {
            val cleanUrl = rawUrl?.trim().orEmpty()
            if (!cleanUrl.startsWith("http")) return
            val cleanName = serverName?.trim()?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
            if (!collectedLinks.containsKey(cleanUrl)) {
                collectedLinks[cleanUrl] = cleanName
            } else if (collectedLinks[cleanUrl].isNullOrBlank() && cleanName != null) {
                collectedLinks[cleanUrl] = cleanName
            }
        }
        document.select("ul#watch li[data-watch]").forEach { serverEl ->
            val watchUrl = serverEl.attr("data-watch")
            val serverName = serverEl.text().trim()
            Log.d(logTag, "📺 Watch URL: $watchUrl ($serverName)")
            addLink(watchUrl, serverName)
        }
        document.select("ul.List--Download--Wecima--Single li a[href]").forEach { downloadEl ->
            val downloadUrl = downloadEl.attr("href")
            val serverName = downloadEl.selectFirst("quality")?.text()?.trim()
                ?: downloadEl.text().trim()
            Log.d(logTag, "📥 Download URL: $downloadUrl ($serverName)")
            addLink(downloadUrl, serverName)
        }
        document.select("ul.WatchServersList li btn[data-url]").forEach { serverBtn ->
            decodeWecimaUrl(serverBtn.attr("data-url"))?.let { decodedUrl ->
                val serverName = serverBtn.text().trim().ifBlank { serverBtn.parent()?.text()?.trim() }
                addLink(decodedUrl, serverName)
            }
        }

        document.select(".openLinkDown[data-href]").forEach { downloadBtn ->
            decodeWecimaUrl(downloadBtn.attr("data-href"))?.let { decodedUrl ->
                val serverName = downloadBtn.selectFirst("quality")?.text()?.trim()
                addLink(decodedUrl, serverName)
            }
        }

        collectedLinks.entries.toList().amap { (link, serverName) ->
            var targetUrl = link
            val isStreamWishOrHg = targetUrl.contains("hgcloud", ignoreCase = true) ||
                targetUrl.contains("streamwish", ignoreCase = true) ||
                serverName?.contains("hgcloud", ignoreCase = true) == true ||
                serverName?.contains("streamwish", ignoreCase = true) == true

            if (isStreamWishOrHg) {
                val resolved = if (targetUrl.contains("hgcloud", ignoreCase = true)) {
                    resolveHgCloud(targetUrl, mainUrl) ?: replaceStreamWishDomain(targetUrl, mainUrl)
                } else {
                    replaceStreamWishDomain(targetUrl, mainUrl)
                }
                if (resolved.isNotBlank()) {
                    Log.d(logTag, "🔄 Replaced StreamWish/hgcloud: $targetUrl -> $resolved")
                    targetUrl = resolved
                }
            }
            var emittedByBuiltIn = false
            val builtInCallback: (ExtractorLink) -> Unit = { extractorLink ->
                emittedByBuiltIn = true
                callback(extractorLink)
            }

            try {
                loadExtractor(targetUrl, mainUrl, subtitleCallback, builtInCallback)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                logError(e)
            }
            if (!emittedByBuiltIn) {
                try {
                    UniversalExtractor.extract(
                        url = targetUrl,
                        referer = mainUrl,
                        subtitleCallback = subtitleCallback,
                        callback = callback,
                        serverName = serverName
                    )
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    logError(e)
                }
            }

            true
        }

        return collectedLinks.isNotEmpty()
    }
}

package com.witanime

import android.R
import android.app.Activity
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.os.SystemClock
import android.util.Log
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.webkit.CookieManager
import android.webkit.WebView
import android.webkit.WebViewClient
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import kotlin.coroutines.resume
import kotlin.coroutines.suspendCoroutine
internal data class SolverResult(val finalUrl: String, val cookies: String?)

internal object CloudflareSolver {
    private const val TAG = "CF_Cookie_Hunter"
    private const val USER_AGENT = "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 10; K) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/148.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36"

    suspend fun solve(activity: Activity?, initialUrl: String, userAgent: String = USER_AGENT): SolverResult? {
        return suspendCoroutine { continuation ->
            Log.d(TAG, "بدء رحلة صيد الكوكيز للرابط: $initialUrl")

            if (activity == null || activity.isFinishing) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Activity غير متاح.")
                continuation.resume(null)
                return@suspendCoroutine
            }

            Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).post {
                val rootView = activity.findViewById<ViewGroup>(R.id.content) ?: run {
                    continuation.resume(null)
                    return@post
                }

                val container = FrameLayout(activity)
                container.layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
                )
                container.elevation = 100f

                val webView = WebView(activity)
                webView.layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
                )
                webView.alpha = 1f
                webView.isFocusable = true
                webView.isFocusableInTouchMode = true
                webView.isClickable = true

                webView.settings.apply {
                    javaScriptEnabled = true
                    domStorageEnabled = true
                    databaseEnabled = true
                    this.userAgentString = userAgent
                    useWideViewPort = true
                    loadWithOverviewMode = true
                }

                val closeButton = Button(activity).apply {
                    text = "إغلاق / Close"
                    setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#D32F2F"))
                    setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
                    val btnParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
                    ).apply {
                        gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.END
                        setMargins(0, 60, 40, 0)
                    }
                    layoutParams = btnParams
                }

                container.addView(webView)
                container.addView(closeButton)

                val cookieManager = CookieManager.getInstance()
                cookieManager.setAcceptCookie(true)
                cookieManager.setAcceptThirdPartyCookies(webView, true)

                var isSolved = false
                var isProcessingClick = false
                val pollingHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())

                fun finishSuccess(finalUrl: String, reason: String = "غير معروف") {
                    if (!isSolved) {
                        isSolved = true
                        Log.i(TAG, "إغلاق | السبب: $reason | الرابط النهائي: $finalUrl")

                        cookieManager.flush()
                        val finalCookies = cookieManager.getCookie(finalUrl)
                        if (!finalCookies.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                            Log.w(TAG, "🍪 تم صيد الكوكيز بنجاح: $finalCookies")
                        } else {
                            Log.e(TAG, "⚠️ لم يتم العثور على أي كوكيز!")
                        }

                        try {
                            pollingHandler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null)
                            rootView.removeView(container)
                            webView.destroy()
                        } catch (e: Exception) {}
                        continuation.resume(SolverResult(finalUrl, finalCookies))
                    }
                }

                closeButton.setOnClickListener {
                    finishSuccess(webView.url ?: initialUrl, "إغلاق يدوي")
                }

                pollingHandler.postDelayed({
                    finishSuccess(webView.url ?: initialUrl, "Timeout - 60s")
                }, 60000)

                fun simulateRealTouch(view: WebView, cssX: Float, cssY: Float) {
                    val density = activity.resources.displayMetrics.density
                    val realX = cssX * density
                    val realY = cssY * density
                    val downTime = SystemClock.uptimeMillis()
                    val eventTime = SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + 50
                    val downEvent = MotionEvent.obtain(downTime, downTime, MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, realX, realY, 0)
                    view.dispatchTouchEvent(downEvent)
                    view.postDelayed({
                        val upEvent = MotionEvent.obtain(downTime, eventTime, MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, realX, realY, 0)
                        view.dispatchTouchEvent(upEvent)
                        downEvent.recycle()
                        upEvent.recycle()
                    }, 50)
                }

                val targetCssPath = "html > body > div:nth-of-type(1) > div > div:nth-of-type(2) > div"

                fun startPolling() {
                    val runnable = object : Runnable {
                        override fun run() {
                            if (isSolved || isProcessingClick) {
                                pollingHandler.postDelayed(this, 2000)
                                return
                            }

                            val jsGetCoords = """
                                (function(){
                                    try{
                                        var box = document.querySelector("$targetCssPath");
                                        if(!box) return "NO_BOX";
                                        var r = box.getBoundingClientRect();
                                        if(r.width === 0 && r.height === 0) return "NO_BOX";
                                        var size = Math.min(36, Math.max(18, Math.round(r.height * 0.55)));
                                        var margin = Math.round(Math.max(8, r.width * 0.03));
                                        var centerY = r.top + (r.height / 2);
                                        var rightSideX = r.right - (size / 2) - margin;
                                        var leftSideX = r.left + (size / 2) + margin;
                                        return rightSideX + "," + centerY + "|" + leftSideX + "," + centerY;
                                    }catch(e){ return "ERROR"; }
                                })();
                            """.trimIndent()

                            webView.evaluateJavascript(jsGetCoords) { res ->
                                try {
                                    val clean = res?.removeSurrounding("\"")
                                    if (clean != null && clean.contains("|")) {
                                        isProcessingClick = true
                                        val sides = clean.split("|")
                                        val (rx, ry) = sides[0].split(",").map { it.toFloatOrNull() }
                                        val (lx, ly) = sides[1].split(",").map { it.toFloatOrNull() }
                                        if (rx != null && ry != null && lx != null && ly != null) {
                                            simulateRealTouch(webView, rx, ry)
                                            pollingHandler.postDelayed({
                                                simulateRealTouch(webView, lx, ly)
                                                pollingHandler.postDelayed({ isProcessingClick = false }, 3000)
                                            }, 250)
                                        } else { isProcessingClick = false }
                                    }
                                } catch (e: Exception) { isProcessingClick = false }
                            }
                            pollingHandler.postDelayed(this, 2000)
                        }
                    }
                    pollingHandler.post(runnable)
                }

                fun checkBypassSuccess() {
                    if (isSolved) return

                    val currentLiveUrl = webView.url ?: initialUrl
                    val currentCookies = cookieManager.getCookie(currentLiveUrl)

                    if (currentCookies != null && currentCookies.contains("cf_clearance")) {
                        finishSuccess(currentLiveUrl, "تم صيد الكوكيز بنجاح")
                        return
                    }

                    pollingHandler.postDelayed({ checkBypassSuccess() }, 500)
                }

                webView.webViewClient = object : WebViewClient() {
                    override fun onPageStarted(view: WebView?, url: String?, favicon: Bitmap?) {
                        super.onPageStarted(view, url, favicon)
                        if (url != null && url != initialUrl) {
                            Log.w(TAG, "🔄 إعادة توجيه إلى: $url")
                        }
                    }

                    override fun onPageFinished(view: WebView?, url: String?) {
                        super.onPageFinished(view, url)
                        isProcessingClick = false
                        startPolling()
                        checkBypassSuccess()
                    }
                }

                rootView.addView(container)
                val customHeaders = mapOf(
                    "sec-ch-ua" to "\"Chromium\";v=\"148\", \"Google Chrome\";v=\"148\", \"Not/A)Brand\";v=\"99\"",
                    "sec-ch-ua-mobile" to "?1",
                    "sec-ch-ua-platform" to "\"Android\"",
                    "upgrade-insecure-requests" to "1",
                    "accept" to "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.7",
                    "sec-fetch-site" to "none",
                    "sec-fetch-mode" to "navigate",
                    "sec-fetch-user" to "?1",
                    "sec-fetch-dest" to "document",
                    "accept-encoding" to "gzip, deflate, br, zstd",
                    "accept-language" to "ar-EG,ar;q=0.9",
                    "priority" to "u=0, i",
                    "User-Agent" to USER_AGENT // من الجيد تمريره ضمن الهيدرز أيضاً
                )
                webView.loadUrl(initialUrl, customHeaders)
            }
        }
    }
}
